correctness.rationale: For an orthonormal moving basis y1=(cosθ,sinθ), y2=(-sinθ,cosθ), F=1/(cosθ+a sinθ)^2+1/(cosθ-b sinθ)^2. Directly rederived F(0)=2 and F’(0)=2(b-a), forcing strict improvement whenever a≠b. For a=b=q, u=tan²θ reduces F to 2(1+u)(1+q²u)/(1-q²u)^2. Independent sympy differentiation agrees identically with the displayed rational derivative; monotonicity on either side of u=q^-2 gives min{2,2/q²}, with q=0 treated separately. Therefore equality sqrt2 iff a=b and |q|≤1, equivalently positive-semidefinite normalized 2×2 correlation matrix. Finite orientation sampling not used as proof. The equality is for the proof certificate, not the optimal geometric avoidance radius for every shift.
